lines.zh: : 行。不过咱们先说清楚——Sensei 没有占我便宜，剑道公主。我们俩都完全清楚我们这段关系是什么。我不爱他，也不觉得他爱我。

lines.en: : So if {i}you{/i} really think you’re ready to do what most of the class has been doing for a while now, I’ll support you. This harem is still manageable as-is.
lines.zh: : 所以如果{i}你{/i}真的觉得自己已经准备好去做班上大多数人早就做了的事，我会支持你。这个后宫照现在的规模还应付得来。

lines.en: : I am glad to hear that I have your support. And also that you do not love him, as it would be very easy for me to steal your man if you did.
lines.zh: : 很高兴能得到你的支持。也很高兴你不爱他，因为如果你爱，我很轻易就能把你的男人抢走。

lines.en: : If anything, I’m just surprised to hear you even {i}want{/i} to do this. I didn’t think you and Sir were anywhere close to that level yet.
lines.zh: : 反倒是你居然{i}想{/i}做这件事，这让我挺意外的。我没想到你和陛下已经到了那种程度。

lines.en: : Neither did I until an apparition had her way with me. Now, the pleasures of the flesh run wildly through my mind like a shaka of quokkas outrunning a vicious predator they all just lobbed their children at.
lines.zh: : 我也没想到，直到一个幽灵对我为所欲为。如今，肉体的欢愉在我脑海里狂奔，就像一群短尾矮袋鼠甩开一头凶猛的捕食者——而它们刚刚还把自己的孩子朝那头捕食者扔过去。

lines.en: : A shaka?
lines.zh: : 一群什么？

lines.en: : It’s what a group of quokkas is called.
lines.zh: : 一群短尾矮袋鼠就是这么叫的。

lines.en: : Why do you know that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么会知道这个？

lines.en: : Obviously because my love for quokkas has been an undeniable aspect of my character for as long as we have known each other.
lines.zh: : 显然是因为，从我们认识起，我对短尾矮袋鼠的热爱就一直是我这个角色不可否认的一面。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure this is the first time you have ever mentioned them.
lines.zh: : 我很确定这是你第一次提到它们。

lines.en: : Lies. I have always been this way. Everyone knows I am synonymous with love for the quokka. It’s the sole pillar holding who I am as a person up so that I may continue to tower over everyone. Shaka-shaka-hey.
lines.zh: : 谎言。我一直都是这样的。所有人都知道我就是短尾矮袋鼠之爱的代名词。这是支撑我这个人继续高高在上、俯视所有人的唯一支柱。沙卡沙卡嘿。

lines.en: : What’s the plan now, then? Do you even {i}have{/i} a plan? Or do you want to do more research first?
lines.zh: : 那么现在有什么计划？你到底{i}有没有{/i}计划？还是想先做更多研究？

lines.en: : Because I don’t mind finding all these games for you if that’s what you want. Rin and I actually used to play them together all the time until my attraction to her completely overpowered me.
lines.zh: : 因为如果你想的话，我不介意帮你把这些游戏都找出来。Rin 和我以前就经常一起玩，直到我对她的迷恋彻底压倒了我。

lines.en: : If the two of us play these games together, will your attraction to me completely overpower you the same way?
lines.zh: : 如果我们两个一起玩这些游戏，你对我的迷恋也会以同样的方式彻底压倒你吗？

lines.en: : I hope not. That would make it a pattern and I’d be forced to accept that the problem is just me as a whole.
lines.zh: : 我希望不会。那样就会成为一种模式，我就不得不承认，问题出在我这个人整体上。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohgame15

: I appreciate you sharing all of your pornography with me. But I now feel as if this is a road I must walk alone. And that having you so close by while I am trying to liberate Coconut would not help the cause.
lines.zh: : 我很感谢你把所有色情作品都分享给我。但我现在觉得，这条路我必须一个人走。而且在我试图解放 Coconut 的时候，你离得这么近，对大业没有帮助。

lines.en: : It is for that same reason that I will abstain from sharing any “plan” I may currently have. I would like my first sexual encounter to be natural and unplanned, not something rehearsed and reviewed by peers.
lines.zh: : 出于同样的原因，我也不会分享我目前可能有的任何“计划”。我希望我的初次性体验是自然、未经安排的，而不是在同伴面前排练过、审视过的东西。

lines.en: : It was more just me wondering what’s next for you since this is a big change in your life, Kendo Princess. If I had known you were this interested in sex, I’d have lent you a hand sooner.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道你接下来打算怎么办，毕竟这是你人生里一个很大的转变，剑道公主。如果我知道你对性这么感兴趣，我早就帮你一把了。

lines.en: : Thank you for the offer, but I already have my own and have figured out more or less what needs to be done in order for me to reach climax with it.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的好意，不过我已经有自己的手了，而且我已经大致弄明白要靠它达到高潮该做些什么。

lines.en: : That’s...not what I-
lines.zh: : 那……我不是——

lines.en: : May I ask you something, Molly?
lines.zh: : 我能问你一件事吗，Molly？

lines.en: scene tsuneyohgame16
: Well, I can’t really refuse when you use my real name.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你都叫我的本名了，我实在不好拒绝。

lines.en: : Do you regret anything?
lines.zh: : 你后悔过什么吗？

lines.en: : Anything, like...like sexually, you mean? About my relationship with the Supreme Overlord?
lines.zh: : 什么，比如……比如性方面的？关于我和至高霸主的关系？

lines.en: : It seems as if your outlook on this topic does not match that of everyone else.
lines.zh: : 看起来，你对这件事的看法和其他所有人都不一样。

lines.en: : They all speak of love...and jealousy over others seeking the same things as them. But you will allow me to follow you without question.
lines.zh: : 她们都谈论爱……还有对追求同样东西的人的嫉妒。可你却会毫无疑问地允许我追随你。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Uhh...I...I don’t know. I just kind of...do.
lines.zh: : 呃……我……我不知道。我只是……就是这样。

lines.en: : So you care not for romance in any capacity?
lines.zh: : 所以你完全不在乎浪漫关系？

lines.en: : It’s not that. I think it would be nice if Sir was my boyfriend. I just don’t think that’s the situation we’re in and that wanting or expecting that wouldn’t make any sense.
lines.zh: : 也不是。我觉得如果陛下是我男朋友会挺好。我只是觉得我们并不是那种关系，而且想要或期待那种关系也没什么意义。

lines.en: : That’s why it was different with Rin. I wanted to actually {i}date{/i} her...be together as a couple...all of that stuff.
lines.zh: : 所以和 Rin 的时候不一样。我是真的想和她{i}交往{/i}……作为一对情侣在一起……所有那些事。

lines.en: : But now, you don’t. And you are content with just having someone to share a bed with. Correct?
lines.zh: : 可现在你不这么想了。你满足于只是有个能一起上床的人。对吗？

lines.en: : Or a wall. A counter. Whatever’s there, really.
lines.zh: : 或者一面墙。一个吧台。真的，手边有什么就用什么。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohgame17
: Interesting.
lines.zh: : 有意思。

lines.en: : I wonder if it still works that way?
lines.zh: : 我在想，它现在还是那样运作的吗？

lines.en: : If {i}what{/i} works that way?
lines.zh: : {i}什么{/i}还是那样运作？

lines.en: : If your route counts at all.
lines.zh: : 你的路线到底算不算数。

lines.en: : If you’re the type of character who will fade out of the main menu once that route is completed, or if you’re the type to not appear on such a thing in the first place.
lines.zh: : 你是那种路线一完成就从主菜单里淡出的角色，还是那种从一开始就不会出现在主菜单上的角色。

lines.en: : Is it {i}normal{/i} to see relationships like that in games? To have a heroine without an ending? Just one there to pad the numbers in the h-scene gallery?
lines.zh: : 在游戏里看到那样的关系，是{i}正常{/i}的吗？一个有女主角却没有结局的角色？只是用来给 H 场景回想凑数的？

lines.en: : This conversation is starting to remind me of Totono and now I am sad.
lines.zh: : 这段对话开始让我想起 Totono，现在我难过了。

lines.en: : I don’t know what that is.
lines.zh: : 我不知道那是什么。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, the reason heroines like me don’t typically exist inside of visual novels is that I’m just not the type of fantasy people are really looking for.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，像我这样的女主角之所以通常不存在于视觉小说里，是因为我不是人们真正想要的那种幻想。

lines.en: : What they want is someone like Ami. Fetishy..over-exaggerated...loyal to one person and just crazy enough to keep the story interesting. That’s the type of character I like to read and pursue.
lines.zh: : 他们想要的是像 Ami 那样的人。充满性癖……夸张……对一个人忠诚，又刚好疯狂到能让故事保持有趣。那是我喜欢去读、去追求的角色类型。

lines.en: : Nobody wants to read about some girl who just sleeps with her teacher because she likes it and doesn’t really think anything will ever come of it. But that happens in real life all the time.
lines.zh: : 没人想读某个女孩就因为喜欢、而且觉得不会有什么结果，就跟自己老师上床的故事。可这种事在现实里一直在发生。

lines.en: : Then what does that make us? Assuming I feel the same as you. Consumers?
lines.zh: : 那我们算什么？假设我的感受和你一样。消费者？

lines.en: : Do you and I not fit within the real “story” of the Supreme Overlord? Are we just side characters who’d make no appearance in these “true routes” I’ve heard you mention in the past?
lines.zh: : 你和我不都在至高霸主真正的“故事”里吗？还是说我们只是那些配角——在你过去提过的“真路线”里根本不会出现的那种？

lines.en: : The way we are now...probably not. No.
lines.zh: : 以我们现在的状态……大概不会。是的，不会。

lines.en: : We might get endings, but that’s it. Something would need to change for us to get anything more, I think.
lines.zh: : 我们也许会有结局，但也仅此而已。我觉得，要得到更多，总得有什么东西改变。

lines.en: : Could you fall in love with him if it meant extending your time here?
lines.zh: : 如果这意味着能延长你在这里的时间，你会爱上他吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyohgame18
: Like...if the world was a game? And I could keep playing so long as I did that?
lines.zh: : 比如……如果这个世界是一款游戏？而只要我那么做，我就能一直玩下去？

lines.en: : I suppose that is the question I am really asking, yes.
lines.zh: : 我想我问的确实是这个问题，没错。

lines.en: : Could you change yourself if you {i}had{/i} to? To survive.
lines.zh: : 如果{i}有必要{/i}，你能改变自己吗？为了活下去。

lines.en: scene black
: Or would you die? Alone in a quiet room. Surrounded by wires and styrofoam cups, decorated with rehydrated produce and brown-tinted oil.
lines.zh: : 还是会死？死在一间安静的屋子里。被电线和泡沫塑料杯包围，点缀着复水的农产品和泛着褐色的油。

lines.en: : Would you be like Him?
lines.zh: : 你会变得像他吗？

lines.en: : Are you like Him?
lines.zh: : 你像他吗？

lines.en: : Is that why we are here together?
lines.zh: : 这就是我们之所以在这里相聚的原因吗？

lines.en: : Is that why we suffer?
lines.zh: : 这就是我们受苦的原因吗？
